finding.witness: The actual state, request, consumer, and retirement-custody handlers all accept a singleton authentic Active-to-Over update when custody holds and burns a lookalike token under a foreign policy. The configured representative policy mints zero, so its policy validator need not execute and the authentic representative can remain live.
finding.mechanism: retirement_custody.request_binds_burn matches only the held asset name against request.old; burned_of discards the held policy. consumer.check_rep_mints inspects only positive mints under state.representative_policy.
finding.scope: Actual production handler functions in a value-balanced synthetic transaction context; this is not a ledger submission or an authentic-history devnet run.
finding.positiveControl: The same four handlers accept the authentic-policy completion.
negativeControls: A wrong held token name refuses at retirement custody.
Omitting the burn refuses at retirement custody.
Omitting the pinned consumer withdrawal refuses at state.
